description: Aree di circolazione ciclabili is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gavorrano.ldpgis.it. Parte longitudinale della strada, opportunamente delimitata, riservata alla circolazione dei velocipedi.La pista ciclabile può essere realizzata:a. in sede propria, ad unico o doppio senso di marcia, qualora la sua sede sia fisicamente separata da quella relativa ai veicoli a motore ed ai pedoni, attraverso idonei spartitraffico longitudinali fisicamente invalicabili;b. Coverage: IT. Its keywords include progetto-opendata-highvalue, Reti di trasporto. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WFS, ZIP, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
